pages.title: A Build on Wheels
pages.text: Assemble and move a Cart Assembler contraption on a minecart.

pages.title: A Build on Wheels
pages.text: Move a whole assembled build; chassis and glue expand your next mobile project.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Put connected blocks over the assembler, position the cart and activate native assembly. Its native reverse operation can disassemble the result.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Put connected blocks above a Cart Assembler, position a minecart and activate the assembler. Attach a moving structure to the minecart; suitable assembler use can disassemble it again.
